**Job title:** Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer**Location:** Chennai**Reports to:** Manager, IT Systems Administration**Contract:** Permanent, Full\-time**Schedule:** Shift aligning to approximately 4–5 hours of overlap with US Central Time daily; off\-hours availability required for monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests

 **Purpose of the Role**
Newell Brands is seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team. This is a senior\-level, hands\-on role responsible for designing, securing, and operating cloud infrastructure across a multi\-cloud environment that spans Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, as well as on\-premises VMware ESXi infrastructure.  

While Microsoft Azure is the primary platform today, this role requires a strong multi\-cloud mindset and the ability to operate effectively across cloud providers as the organization's footprint evolves. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in cloud security, networking, and complex troubleshooting, and can work independently with minimal direction in a globally distributed team. This role requires a work schedule providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time, as well as availability outside normal hours for scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests. Experience with VMware technologies, including VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), is a valued plus. **Your Key Responsibilities:****Cloud Infrastructure \& Operations**

* Design, deploy, and manage scalable infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, including compute, storage, and container platforms such as AKS and EKS
* Maintain and optimize cloud account structures including Azure subscriptions, AWS accounts, and landing zones across providers
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates with a preference for cloud\-agnostic tooling where practical
* Implement automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, AWS CLI, and native cloud automation services to reduce manual effort and improve consistency
* Monitor infrastructure health across cloud platforms using Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Log Analytics, and other native tools, responding proactively to alerts and capacity trends

**Cloud Security**

* Architect and enforce security controls across cloud environments in alignment with Zero Trust principles and a consistent multi\-cloud security posture
* Manage Azure Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) and AWS IAM policies across cloud environments
* Conduct security assessments and remediate findings from vulnerability scans, cloud security posture tools, and policy compliance checks
* Manage secrets governance including Azure Key Vault and AWS Secrets Manager, encryption at rest and in transit, and key lifecycle management
* Maintain compliance posture across regulatory and corporate policy requirements in all cloud environments

**Cloud Networking**

* Design and manage virtual network topologies across Azure (VNets, hub\-spoke) and AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateway) with consistent routing and segmentation standards
* Configure and maintain cloud\-native firewalls, Network Security Groups (NSGs), security groups, and DDoS protection across providers
* Implement and operate load balancing and traffic management services including Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, and AWS equivalents
* Manage Azure DNS, Private DNS Zones, AWS Route 53, and name resolution across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments including routing, connectivity, and DNS resolution failures

**Troubleshooting \& Incident Response**

* Serve as a senior escalation point for cloud infrastructure incidents across all platforms, driving rapid diagnosis and resolution
* Lead post\-incident reviews, document root cause analyses, and implement preventive measures
* Use platform\-native diagnostics and log analytics tools to investigate performance degradation and outages
* Participate in on\-call rotation for critical infrastructure support as needed

**Maintenance, DR, \& Business Continuity**

* Actively participate in monthly infrastructure maintenance windows, which are scheduled outside of normal business hours
* Support semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests, including failover validation, documentation, and post\-test reporting
* Contribute to DR planning and runbook development to ensure recovery procedures remain current and tested across cloud environments

**On\-Premises \& Collaboration**

* Support VMware ESXi and on\-premises virtualization environments as needed
* Contribute to cloud adoption and migration projects, providing multi\-cloud expertise during design and execution phases
* Share technical knowledge across the team; contribute to infrastructure standards, runbooks, and architectural decision records

 **What You’ll Need:****Minimum:*** 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud infrastructure, with strong depth in at least two major cloud platforms (Azure required; AWS strongly preferred)
* Demonstrated expertise in cloud security fundamentals including RBAC/IAM, Zero Trust principles, secrets governance, and encryption; working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, and PIM
* Strong cloud networking skills spanning virtual networks, firewalls, load balancers, DNS, and Private DNS Zones across Azure and AWS
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues across compute, storage, networking, and identity layers in a multi\-cloud environment
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates
* Proficiency in cloud automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and/or AWS CLI
* Familiarity with cloud monitoring and observability tools across providers (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, AWS CloudWatch)
* Comfortable working outside normal hours to support scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
* Ability to work a shift providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time
* Strong documentation skills and ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Business\-level English proficiency (verbal and written) required
* Ability to work independently and effectively in a fully remote environment across global time zones.

 **Your Advantage:*** Cloud certifications — one or more of the following are preferred:
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\)
* AZ\-700: Designing and Implementing Microsoft Azure Networking Solutions
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF9\) or prior VMware vSphere/ESXi administration
* Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) in a production environment
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions

title: Data Capability Engineer
description:
**Job title:** Data Capability Engineer**Location:** Chennai**Reports to:** IT Systems Architecture**Contract:** Permanent, Full\-time **Purpose of the Role:**
Own and extend the accuracy, completeness, and usability of the service management platform's data — so implementation teams and AI\-driven capabilities can act on it directly, and so priority consumers like vulnerability and exposure management run on complete, trustworthy ground truth. Service mapping and asset data are the anchor domain and immediate priority; the durable mandate is data quality across an increasingly AI\-centric ITSM platform, where automated systems act on data without a human to catch errors first.  

**A data\-capability role, not a security role.** **Core responsibilities — Anchor domain: Service \& asset data (immediate priority)**  

* Ensure existing service mapping is accurate and current across hosts, servers, and applications.
* Extend mapping coverage to data types not well covered today — certificates, websites, agents, and SaaS applications.
* Engage in the workflows that onboard new applications and capabilities into the CMDB so coverage keeps pace rather than drifting.
* Go deeper into discovery and software\-asset tooling — Lansweeper, the software asset management system, and agent\-based discovery — to raise inventory fidelity.
 **Core responsibilities — Broader mandate: Platform \& AI\-consumption data quality**  

* Apply the same discipline to other high\-value platform data — service catalog and metadata, ticket routing and assignment\-group data, and the Dataverse structures underneath delivery capabilities such as the AskIT service chatbot.
* Raise data to the standard AI systems require: complete, disambiguated, and semantically clean, so intent classification, catalog matching, and automated routing act on trustworthy inputs rather than amplifying noise.
* Leverage the existing foundation (Dataverse schema, discovery tooling, search indexes already in place) rather than building net\-new infrastructure.
* Make data consumable without re\-verification \- the test is whether an engineer or an automated agent can act on a record without re\-checking it, and turn recurring data problems into repeatable quality practices.
 **What this role is not**  

* **Not remediation coordination or change management**
* **Not a security function \-** it supplies the data; it does not own security decisions.
* **Not a net\-new platform build \-** leverages and improves the existing foundation.
 **Example Success measures**  

* **Coverage:** % of assets, certificates, websites, agents, and SaaS apps mapped to owner and service; extended over time to other platform data domains.
* **Data confidence:** high enough that implementation teams and AI capabilities don't require re\-verification.
* **Time\-to\-onboard** a new application or capability into the CMDB.
* **Reusability:** improvements delivered as repeatable practices, not one\-off fixes.
 **What You’ll Need:****Education:**  

Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, data management, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. A candidate with a strong track record in CMDB, discovery, or data\-quality work should not be screened out for lack of the exact degree. **Experience:**  

Five to eight years in IT data, configuration/asset management, or a data\-engineering\-adjacent role, including demonstrable ownership of a data domain (not just contributing to one). Enough experience to set the standard for how data quality is done, with the judgment to work independently under a Senior Manager's direction rather than needing task\-level supervision. **Required skills and knowledge**  

**Anchor domain — asset \& service data**  

* Hands\-on experience with CMDB and service mapping concepts (configuration items, relationships, service dependencies), including keeping mapping accurate as the environment changes.
* Working knowledge of discovery and software\-asset tooling — Lansweeper, agent\-based discovery, and a software asset management system — and what drives inventory fidelity in each.
* Understanding of the asset types the role must extend into: certificates, websites, agents, and SaaS applications.
 **Broader mandate — platform \& AI\-consumption data quality**  

* Strong data\-quality fundamentals: profiling, deduplication, normalization, and defining and measuring completeness and accuracy.
* Practical experience querying and shaping data in a structured platform (Dataverse or a comparable relational/low\-code data platform), working with existing schema rather than designing greenfield systems.
* Query capability sufficient to investigate, validate, and correct data at scale independently.
* Familiarity with what makes data consumable by AI systems — why completeness, disambiguation, and clean semantics matter for intent classification, matching, and routing. Deep machine\-learning expertise is not required; the relevant skill is data readiness, not model building.
 **Ways of working**  

* Able to embed quality into existing onboarding workflows and turn recurring problems into repeatable practices, rather than one\-off fixes.
* Communicates data issues and their business impact clearly to both technical teams and non\-technical stakeholders.
 **Your Advantage:*** Experience in a Microsoft Power Platform environment (Power Automate, Azure AI Search, or similar).
* Exposure to vulnerability or exposure management as a data consumer — understanding what that function needs from asset data, without owning the security decisions.
* ITIL familiarity (service management context), or a data\-management certification (e.g., DAMA/CDMP).

The Body Construction Engineering Manager – Process Simulation \& Virtual Commissioning is responsible for leading and developing a high\-performing engineering team supporting Body\-in\-White (BIW) manufacturing operations through advanced digital manufacturing technologies.


This role provides both technical and people leadership across process simulation, robotics validation, virtual commissioning, automation, and digital transformation initiatives. The position works closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Controls Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing IT, suppliers, and plant operations teams to identify manufacturing risks early, optimize manufacturing processes, and improve production readiness prior to equipment installation and production launch.


The successful candidate will play a key role in advancing digital manufacturing capabilities, improving engineering efficiency, and establishing simulation and virtual commissioning standards across multiple automotive manufacturing programs and facilities.

**Team Leadership \& Capability Development**

* Build, lead, and develop a Body Process Simulation team supporting BIW manufacturing engineering activities.
* Define team structure, technical responsibilities, engineering standards, work processes, deliverables, and performance expectations.
* Lead, mentor, and coordinate a multidisciplinary team of engineers, simulation specialists, controls engineers, contractors, and supplier resources.
* Recruit, develop, and retain technical talent in process simulation, robotics, offline programming, virtual commissioning, automation, and digital manufacturing technologies.
* Establish competency frameworks, mentoring programs, training plans, and career development pathways.
* Manage resource planning, project workloads, budgets, supplier support, and delivery performance across multiple manufacturing programs and locations.
* Foster a culture focused on safety, collaboration, innovation, quality, continuous improvement, and standardization.

**Process Simulation \& Digital Manufacturing**

* Lead the application of Siemens Process Simulate, Tecnomatix, or similar digital manufacturing tools to validate body shop manufacturing processes prior to equipment installation.
* Establish standard methodologies for:
* Robot reach and accessibility studies
* Collision detection and avoidance
* Cycle time validation
* Tooling and weld gun accessibility validation
* Ergonomic assessments
* Robot path optimization
* Station layout verification
* Ensure simulation activities support manufacturing feasibility reviews, equipment design validation, tooling development, and process planning.
* Develop and maintain simulation models, robot libraries, tooling standards, process libraries, work instructions, and best practices.
* Improve simulation quality, model accuracy, data management practices, and process validation efficiency.
* Identify and communicate manufacturing risks, design concerns, capacity constraints, automation challenges, and process issues early during program development.

**Virtual Commissioning**

* Develop organizational capability in virtual commissioning technologies and methodologies.
* Lead validation of robot sequences, programmable logic controller (PLC) logic, safety interlocks, equipment interfaces, and automated manufacturing processes in a virtual environment.
* Define virtual commissioning standards, test procedures, acceptance criteria, and deployment methodologies.
* Collaborate with Controls Engineering, equipment suppliers, and plant teams to ensure an effective transition from virtual to physical commissioning.
* Support issue resolution related to robotics, controls, automation systems, simulation models, commissioning activities, and production support.

**Automation \& Digital Transformation**

* Drive automation and digital manufacturing initiatives to improve simulation efficiency, engineering productivity, and manufacturing validation processes.
* Identify opportunities to automate model creation, reporting, data validation, engineering analysis, and repetitive simulation activities.
* Support the adoption of advanced digital tools, data analytics, digital twins, and AI\-enabled engineering solutions to improve:
* Engineering productivity
* Manufacturing risk identification
* Root\-cause analysis
* Knowledge management
* Decision support
* Partner with Manufacturing IT, Controls Engineering, Product Development, and Data \& Analytics teams to evaluate and implement scalable digital manufacturing solutions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 7\+ years of experience in automotive Body\-in\-White manufacturing, process engineering, manufacturing launches, equipment installation, commissioning, production trials, and ramp\-up activities.
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience in digital manufacturing, process simulation, robotics validation.
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience in Virtual commissioning.
* Proven experience leading and developing engineering teams and coordinating supplier and contractor resources.
* Hands\-on experience with Siemens Process Simulate, Tecnomatix, or equivalent manufacturing simulation platforms.
* Strong knowledge of body shop robotics, tooling, fixtures, automated manufacturing cells, and material handling systems.
* Working knowledge of industrial controls, PLC architecture, automation sequencing, robot\-controls integration, and virtual commissioning principles.
* Knowledge of BIW joining technologies, including resistance spot welding, arc welding, laser welding, adhesive bonding, riveting, clinching, or related manufacturing processes.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting multiple automotive OEM manufacturing environments.
* Advanced experience in offline robot programming and virtual commissioning.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled engineering tools, digital twin technologies, or manufacturing analytics solutions.
* Knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD\&T), Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), Control Plans, and structured problem\-solving methodologies.
* Experience leading large, cross\-functional engineering teams across multiple manufacturing locations.

The role focuses primarily on production\-grade Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), retrieval quality, embeddings, reranking, context engineering, LLM integration, guardrails and AI evaluation.

* Work with local and hosted embedding models.

* Support future proactive/agentic workflows while maintaining bounded actions and human accountability.

**J****ob Description: Supply Chain Analyst – AI\-Enabled Supply Continuity \& Process Innovation**

**Position Overview**


We are looking for a proactive Supply Chain Analyst who can navigate the tension between traditional supply assurance — supplier follow\-up, delivery risk assessment, and expediting decisions — and the new frontier of AI\-powered process innovation. This role is designed for someone who can partner with IT and Analytics teams to co\-create intelligent automations while simultaneously building their own lightweight AI tools (using Microsoft Copilot and Office 365\) to reduce manual effort, improve decision speed, and democratize AI capability across the supply chain function.

**When applying for this position, please ensure you use your** **external\-facing profile / resume** **to avoid screening rejection**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Supplier Delivery Follow\-Up \& Line Risk Management –** Own day\-to\-day follow\-up with suppliers on delivery commitments; proactively identify at\-risk orders using AI\-generated alerts and predictive flags, and make real\-time expediting decisions (air freight, alternate sourcing, buffer stock) to prevent line stoppages.
* **AI\-Augmented Risk Assessment \& Escalation** – Leverage AI/ML\-based scoring (powered by models built in collaboration with Analytics or prototyped via Copilot/Python) to quantify supplier risk across dimensions like lead time vulnerability, past reliability, and financial health, enabling prioritized escalation.
* **Data\-Driven Expedite Decisioning –** Use predictive scenario modeling and AI\-generated recommendations to determine when expediting is truly necessary, balancing premium cost against production downtime risk, with clear reasoning documented for audit trails.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration with IT \& Analytics –** Act as the supply chain subject matter expert embedded in cross\-functional squads with IT and Data Analytics, translating manual workflows into technical requirements for automation, AI agents, and intelligent dashboards.
* **Microsoft Copilot \& Office 365 Agentic Automation** – Build and deploy Copilot\-powered AI agents within Office 365 (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, Power Automate) to auto\-generate weekly delivery status decks, draft supplier escalation emails, summarize meeting action items, and create workflow\-based automations that eliminate repetitive tasks.
